messages:
kate: Quick sync — postmortem action item: noisy DB_CONN_TIMEOUT alerts. Last incident triggered ~120 pages in 10m. Proposing a 'fuzzy dedupe' layer and short suppression window for the downstream replicas.
ryan: Ack. Can you sketch what 'fuzzy' means? group by error class + host prefix? :thinking:
sophia: We should keep at least one page for each kv-shard owner, otherwise we lose visibility. Maybe dedupe by (error fingerprint, shard_id) with a 5m suppress.
jamal: What about events that flip rapidly? I saw alerts clear then re-fire because of transient socket blips. We should avoid re-paging on quick flaps.
kate: Agreed. Draft approach: 1) fingerprint = hash(error_code + normalized_msg) 2) attach resource tag (shard or region) 3) suppression window = 4m for same fingerprint+resource, 10m if the same fingerprint across >3 hosts.
ryan: That 3-host rule sounds smart. Who owns implementing the filter and updating the alert rule? @sophia? :+1:
sophia: I can own the rule changes. ETA EOW for a PoC that runs in the alert proxy and a staging test run.
oncall-bot: Reminder: page-rotation duty for this week is jamal. Use /oncall handoff when done.
jamal: I'll help validate and run the staging sweep. Can we add a metric to count suppressed pages? want to measure impact.
kate: Yes — add metric: alerts.suppressed.count with tags (fingerprint, resource, window). Also add a counter for alerts.repaged_after_suppression to catch regressions.
sophia: Example rule snippet I'm planning to push to staging:
```
alert: DBConnTimeout
expr: increase(db_conn_timeouts_total[1m]) > 0
labels:
  fingerprint: '{{ error_code }}:{{ normalized_msg_hash }}'
annotations:
  runbook: 'https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-timeout'
```
I'll add a middleware to compute fingerprint and check suppression cache.
ryan: Can we also record the PM ticket number on the alert so oncall can link back? maybe label runbook with pm-#.
kate: Good call. Add label pm_ticket: PM-4721. Owner matrix: sophia (rule + metric) ETA Fri, jamal (staging validation) ETA Mon, ryan (rollback playbook + docs) ETA Tue next week.
sophia: I'll post the PR in #eng-releases when ready. Will also include a short demo script to simulate bursts.
jamal: After staging run, I want a 24h observation window before we flip in prod. If suppression causes missed SLOs we revert.
kate: Sounds good. Action items summarized:
- sophia: implement fuzzy fingerprinting + suppression cache, push PoC to staging (due Fri)
- jamal: run staging burst validation + collect suppressed metrics (due Mon)
- ryan: write rollback/mitigation steps and update runbook (due Tue)
- kate: schedule 24h observation post-prod flip and verify alert.retention logs (me)
We'll reconvene Fri morning for a status update.
ryan: Thanks. I'll add a short checklist to the postmortem ticket.
sophia: On it. Thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
oncall-bot: Note: Created task tracker item #INC-ACT-993 for follow-ups.
